text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's cabinet supports United Nations resolution which condemned Israel's construction of a settlement in East Jerusalem.
- Al Ahlia Insurance posted a net profit of 11,687 dinars in 1996 compared to a 472,532 dinar loss in 1995.
- An amount of 3.6 million dinars is to be spent on building a new control tower at Bahrain International Airport.
- Bahrain investors urged to consider France Telecom, which is set to be sold in June.
- Kazakhstan's president to visit Bahrain on May 19 to boost relations between the two countries.
- Bahrain's hotels witness good growth in the first quarter of 1997.
- Bahrain to participate in an agriculture and water conference in Cairo on Tuesday.
